verdict.rationale: Granola supports several background automations - auto-drafted follow-up emails, overnight pre-meeting briefs, automatic HubSpot CRM sync from folders, and Zapier connections to 8,000+ apps that trigger post-meeting - plus an API for building custom agents. However these are mostly pre-built, single-purpose automations rather than a native, user-configurable 'set up autonomous agents' system; true autonomous agentic workflows require external tools (Zapier, custom API-built agents, MCP-connected assistants) rather than being built into Granola itself. Missing for 10: a native in-app automation/rules builder for arbitrary background tasks, and independent evidence of these automations running reliably unattended over time.
